process.label: Process
process.title: From first message to a live website
process.description: You always know which stage you are in and what comes next. No silent gaps.
process.step1Desc: A 30-minute call or Zalo chat about your industry, goals and budget. You get a written quote the same day.
process.step2Desc: Sign the contract and pay a 50% deposit, then send your logo, photos and copy. No copy yet? We provide an industry template for you to fill in.
process.step3Desc: We send the interface design for review. Revise it as much as you like at this stage; we only start building once you are happy.
process.step4Desc: We build the theme, load your content, install SSL, tune performance and on-page SEO, and register the site with Google.
process.step5Desc: You receive every domain, hosting and admin account, plus live training on posting, swapping images and editing content. Final 50% is due here.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: What clients ask most
faq.description: If your question is not here, message us on Zalo and you will get an answer right away.
faq.q1: How long until my website is ready?
faq.a1: Landing pages take 5-7 days, business websites 10-15 days, and online stores 20-30 days, counted from when we receive your content and logo. If your content is not ready yet, the clock starts when it arrives.
faq.q2: What do I pay in the second year?
faq.a2: Between 1,200,000₫ and 2,500,000₫ per year depending on the package, covering only the domain, hosting, SSL and backups. That figure is written into the contract from the start, and if you would rather manage it yourself or move to another provider, we hand everything over free of charge.
faq.q3: I am not technical. Can I still edit the content?
faq.a3: Yes. Editing WordPress content works much like writing a document. At handover we run a live training session and record it so you can rewatch it any time. Most clients are publishing their own posts within the first week.
faq.q4: Whose name are the domain and hosting under?
faq.a4: Yours, or your company's, from the moment they are registered. At the end of the project you receive every email, password and top-level admin right.
faq.q5: Do I see the design before the build starts?
faq.a5: Yes. You approve the interface design and revise it until you are satisfied before we write a line of code. That avoids finishing a site only to find it does not suit you.
faq.q6: Will my website rank on Google?
faq.a6: We handle on-page SEO, register Search Console and submit your sitemap at handover, which is what Google needs to index the site. Where individual keywords rank depends on your content and competition and takes ongoing SEO work. We do not promise instant top rankings.
faq.q7: I already have a website. Can I move it over?
faq.a7: Yes. We migrate your existing data and posts to the new hosting and keep the URLs intact so you do not lose the rankings you already have. If your previous provider will not cooperate, we help you recover control of the domain.
faq.a8: In two stages: 50% on signing and 50% at handover, once you have checked the site works as agreed. VAT invoices issued on request.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Linkable is committed to protecting client information. This policy explains how we collect, use and safeguard your personal data.
s1Items: Contact details: name, email, phone number, address
Business information, where you choose to provide it
Message content and project requests sent through our contact form
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device used
s2Items: Responding to enquiries and sending quotes
Delivering the contract and handing over the project
Technical support during the warranty period
privacy.s3Text: We do not sell, trade or rent your personal data. Information is shared only with domain registrars and hosting providers, to the minimum extent needed to register services in your name, or where lawfully required by a public authority.
privacy.s4Text: We apply appropriate security measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. The entire website is served over an encrypted SSL connection.
privacy.s5Text: Contact details are kept for up to 24 months after our last exchange. Contract-related records are retained for the period required by accounting and tax law.

Request deletion of your personal data
